I was planning a product launch and I was 90% confident it would succeed. >> That sounds pretty confident. >> It was. But someone in my truth seeeking group asked what would make you only 80% confident. And that made you reconsider. >> It forced me to articulate my assumptions and I realized I was assuming customer behavior that I hadn't actually validated. >> So you caught a blind spot before it became a problem. >> Exactly.
